# Forex Notes

> Forex Notes (forexnotes.in) is a trading journal, bar replay backtester and AI psychology coach for forex, gold (XAUUSD), indices and crypto traders, with prop firm drawdown and lot size calculators. Plans are $14/month or $114/year with a free trial; card and USDT (BEP-20) payments.

Forex Notes is software only. It is not a broker, does not hold funds or execute trades, and does not give investment advice.

- [The Forex Trading Journal for High-Capital Dubai Traders](https://forexnotes.in/dubai/forex-trading-journal): Top trading journal for Dubai & UAE prop firm traders. Track multi-funded accounts, calculate AED margin & leverage, and log swap-free trades from $14/mo.
